items.quote: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham
items.claim: Ishmael is Abraham's son born to Hagar, an Egyptian who was Sarah's handmaid

items.quote: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam
items.claim: Ishmael's firstborn son was Nebajoth; his other sons included Kedar, Adbeel, and Mibsam

items.quote: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa
items.claim: Three additional sons of Ishmael were Mishma, Dumah, and Massa

items.quote: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah
items.claim: Five more sons of Ishmael were Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah

items.quote: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations
items.claim: Ishmael had twelve sons who were princes; they are identified by their towns and castles according to their nations
